thread_title: Preview: Traphase Pausing New Updates, Entering Balance Maintenance Mode

content:
I wish Morimens was like Endfield and just didn't do RNG substats at all, but tbh the only thing it needs right now is QoL to kill the clicking

TBH I'd love to see it joined up more nicely with the daily send-out-Awakeners-for-mats thing, just let us assign Awakeners to slowly improve slices over time instead of getting useless green mats

Like if you are fishing for a CR slice and you get 3x CR but they're all level 1, maybe you can give that to some Awakeners for a few weeks to slowly improve it it to 8/8/8

Something something Arknights Base mechanics
